mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS levels, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 60% of the 5-day windows following a UNRATE drop, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and the unemployment rate is already low, it may signal a tightening labor market and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day windows following the trigger conditions, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should translate to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following GDPC1 growth, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and higher corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 5-day windows following PAYEMS increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following INDPRO increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales increase and the federal funds rate is low, it indicates strong consumer demand and easy monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following the trigger conditions, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates a tightening monetary policy, which may lead to reduced borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 20-day windows following high FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.
